What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 7.29, 0.71 under the 8.0 top rung. The art median is 6.5 and the craft floor stood down at the cap.
  • The kit figures on frames 5 and 8 still read as mannequins at full size, and frame 3's far lids still alias.
  • Frame 6 shows 13 pavers inside the frame against a headline of fourteen; the first is cropped at the bottom.
  • The caption's closing question presupposes the unread faculty and staff PDF is a separate policy, named by the round 3 integrity judge and left at the cap.
  • The hero and the field of desks repeat no. 38's from September 30th; two judges scored variety 4.5 and 5.5 for it.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Austin Community College is writing its AI policy, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Austin Community College calls its coming AI policy its "first-ever."

Its October 9th post says a framework called TRUST is meant to help shape it. The third rule reads "AI can support your work, but it should never replace your expertise, decision-making, or responsibility." The college says more than 79,000 students rely on it each year.

The Faculty and Student AI Town Hall on October 12th at the Rio Grande Campus will explore in-progress AI policies. The October 22nd seminar at the Highland Campus is open to community members.

The college's AI Resource Hub already links a PDF titled Acceptable Use of Artificial Intelligence Policy, marked for faculty and staff only.

The post names no adoption date, no vote and no adopting body. Who decides whether the new policy replaces that document or sits beside it?

#AustinCommunityCollege #AustinTX #TRUSTFramework

The machine changed itself

  • The weekly digest's ranked artwork defects section reads the key the judges write
    It had been empty for all five weekly passes because it read a key the judges stopped writing on October 3rd.
  • The clinical cart from no. 47 is now a kit model with a moulded monitor back, vents, a VESA mount, a cable run and a cool rim of light
    Every judge named the flat monitor back in every round of no. 47.
  • For a maintainer, the GRID piece count reads a lit floor as the subject on four decks
    Three pixel fixes either loosened or broke the gate; the proposal counts units from the engine's scene (UPGRADE_BACKLOG 2026-10-10 item 3).
  • For a maintainer, tests/article_edition.mjs still saves its screenshots to September 18th's folder
    Three runs have had to screenshot their own edition by hand (UPGRADE_BACKLOG 2026-10-10 item 4).

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

Carousel no. 48 is Austin Community College's AI policy, tx-2026-0212, admitted today. The college calls the coming policy its first-ever, and its own AI Resource Hub already links a PDF titled Acceptable Use of Artificial Intelligence Policy, marked for faculty and staff only. The post names no adoption date, vote or adopting body. The town hall is Monday, October 12th at 6:30 p.m. The deck shipped at the round cap at 7.29, with no hard fail in any round (7.12, then 7.242, then 7.29). Frames 4, 5, 8 and 9 were recomposed after two panel rounds named them, and the close now shows the empty seat rather than a walker. The weekly machine pass ran: the week digest's ranked defects section works again and no. 47's cart is a kit model. Two items wait on a maintainer: the GRID piece count and the article test's screenshot folder. The record: 33 items were due and re-verified through the crawl boundary. FAA's site refuses this project's agent, so 152 of its claims stayed undecided by their own source. A first hand-check helper ignored two items' measured robots blocks; its results were discarded and it was rewritten. A scout brief named a host the registry puts off limits; nothing from it reached a claims file.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
